title: 第25章 氪金系统与抽卡系统第26章 米拉贝拉
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
“勇气之心与平易近人，这两个技能应该就是勇气与魅力到了Lv2之后系统赠送的技能了？那这么说的话，其他三个属性升到Lv2之后应该还会再有其他的技能。
如果能把体魄的技能在入学考试前拿到就好了。”
法伦看着两个技能，自言自语道。
根据已有的两个技能名字与效果，法伦很容易就推测出，体魄的技能估计是和身体素质有关的，不管是对于后面的召唤决斗比赛，还是入学考试都非常重要。
法伦退出了五维属性界面，随后点开了那个新开放的召唤界面。
进去之后又出现三个可选择的模块，分别是：召唤兽、召唤术、魔法卡。
但是召唤术与魔法卡的界面还是灰色的未开放状态，有了上次经验的法伦很快就明白了，估计是自己还没掌握相关知识，所以想要点开这两个界面估计得先掌握召唤术与魔法卡的基础知识才行。
没有办法的法伦点开了召唤兽的界面，映入眼帘的就是杰克霜精的展示页面，只是现在的杰克霜精似乎是在睡觉，坐在地上，法伦甚至能看到他打呼噜的鼻涕泡。
法伦拉开了左边的属性页面，里面有杰克霜精详细的资料。
【名字：杰克霜精
种属：幻想妖精种
属性：冰
力：5
魔：9
耐：8
速：6
运：4
好感度：60
掌握技能：冰霜操控、音速拳】
“果然有音速拳，我记得这个技能是对体型小的生物容易造成暴击，看来作为一个隐藏的杀招不错。”

法伦思索了起来，在战斗的时候，谁都不会想到这看上去人畜无害的小家伙会突然使出一记简单粗暴的直拳。
“不过4点的运气有机会打出暴击嘛。”
法伦对杰克霜精的数值有些无奈，“除了那个香薰卡之外有没有什么其他让召唤兽的变强手段呢？”
今天将杰克霜精召唤出来之后，法伦马上就联想到了之前的任务奖励给的香薰套装是什么了，没记错的话那是《女神异闻录3》里给仲魔数值强化用的东西。
但低级的香薰卡一般都只能给数值+1，即使是一套加下去对于杰克霜精来说都不算很大的提升。
另外，法伦还看到了杰克霜精名字的隔壁出现了很多卡牌游戏都有的升星按钮，十个碎片可以提升一次星级，一共有五颗星，目前杰克霜精只有一颗星。
“蓝色品质的杰克霜精可以升四次的意思吗？按照我这么多年玩手游的经验，那应该是可以升到金色品质？但是金色品质的杰克霜精会有什么不同呢？难度还能进化成霜精之王不成？”
退出了召唤界面，法伦把目光放到了最后一个商店界面，心里有种不妙的感觉，之前杰克霜精升星所需的碎片估计就是在这里获取的了。
思考片刻之后，法伦还是点开了商店界面，果然不出他所料，一进去就是一个大大的抽卡界面。
“我就知道！”
法伦有些抓狂，没想到跑到了异世界，氪金手游还在追自己。
眼前呈现的是一个极其简约的抽卡界面，正中央摆放着当期抽取概率提升的召唤兽——一个淡红色肌肤、手持长剑的金发男子。
每次抽奖需要消耗10点数，而一次性抽取十次则只需要90点数，但十次抽奖必定会获得一只蓝色品质的召唤兽.
法伦一眼就认出了这个当期UP的召唤兽，它正是来自《女神异闻录》中的仲魔齐格飞。
难道只要抽出来，它就会成为我的召唤兽吗？而且新手首次十连竟然还有八折优惠？这简直就是典型的手游抽卡界面！
法伦一边思考，一边自言自语道。
content_en:
"Courage and approachability, these two skills should be the skills given by the system after courage and charm reach Lv2? In that case, there should be other skills after the other three attributes reach Lv2.
It would be great if I could acquire physical skills before the entrance exam. "
Fallon looked at the two skills and said to himself.
Based on the names and effects of the two existing skills, Fallon can easily deduce that the physical skill is probably related to physical fitness, which is very important for the subsequent summoning duel competition and the entrance exam.
Fallon exited the five-dimensional attribute interface, and then clicked on the newly opened summoning interface.
After entering, three optional modules appear, namely: Summoned Beast, Summoning Spell, and Magic Card.
However, the interfaces for Summoning and Magic Cards were still gray and unopened. Fallon, who had the previous experience, quickly understood that he probably had not mastered the relevant knowledge yet, so if he wanted to open these two interfaces, he probably had to master the basic knowledge of Summoning and Magic Cards first.
With no choice, Fallon clicked on the summoned beast interface, and what came into view was the display page of Jack Frost. However, Jack Frost seemed to be sleeping now. Sitting on the ground, Fallon could even see the snot bubbles from his snoring.
Fallon opened the properties page on the left, which contained detailed information about Jack Frost.
[Name: Jack Frost
Species: fantasy fairy species
Properties: ice
Strength: 5
Magic: 9
Resistance: 8
Speed: 6
Luck: 4
Favorability: 60
Skills mastered: Frost Control, Sonic Fist]
"Sure enough, there is Sonic Punch. I remember that this skill can easily cause critical hits to small creatures. It seems to be a good hidden killing move."
Fallon thought about it. During the fight, no one would have thought that this seemingly harmless little guy would suddenly throw a simple and rough straight punch.
"But with 4 points of luck, there is a chance of a critical hit."
Fallon was a little helpless about Jack Frost's numerical value, "Besides the Aromatherapy Card, are there any other ways to make the summoned beast stronger?"
After summoning the Jack Frost Spirit today, Fallon immediately thought of what the aromatherapy set was as a reward from the previous mission. If I remember correctly, it was something used to enhance the Nakama's numerical value in "Persona 3".
However, low-level aromatherapy cards generally only give +1 to the value. Even adding one set is not a big improvement for Jack Frost.
In addition, Fallon also saw the star-up button that appears in many card games next to the name of Jack Frost. Ten fragments can increase the star level once. There are five stars in total. Currently, Jack Frost has only one star.
"Does it mean that the blue-quality Jack Frost Spirit can be upgraded four times? According to my experience in playing mobile games for so many years, it should be able to be upgraded to gold quality? But what will be the difference between the gold-quality Jack Frost Spirit? Can the difficulty evolve into the King of Frost Spirits?"
After exiting the summoning interface, Fallon turned his attention to the last store interface, feeling a bad feeling in his heart. It was probably here that the fragments needed for Jack Frost to ascend to the star were obtained.
After thinking for a moment, Fallon clicked on the store interface. As expected, as soon as he entered, there was a large card drawing interface.
"I knew it!"
Fallon was a little crazy. Unexpectedly, he ran to a different world, and the krypton gold mobile game was still chasing him.
What appeared in front of him was an extremely simple card drawing interface. In the center was a summoned beast with an increased probability of being drawn for the current period - a blond man with light red skin and holding a long sword.
Each draw costs 10 points, and drawing ten times at one time only costs 90 points, but you will definitely get a blue-quality summoned beast after ten draws.
Fallon recognized this current UP summoned beast at a glance. It was exactly the one from "Persona"Zhongmo Siegfried.
Will it become my summoned beast as long as I take it out? And there’s a 20% discount for a novice’s first ten-consecutive session? This is simply a typical mobile game card drawing interface!
Fallon thought to himself.
